messages:
anya: ran the golden-sweep across 6 variants (raven-lite, raven-int8, zephyr2-int4, kestrel-ptq, harbor3q, sparrow-lite). summary: overall funcall schema pass dropped from 98.7% -> 92.1 for raven-int8 when prefix > 1k tokens.

jordan: ugh. is that reproducible w/ the same seed + mirror?

anya: yes, reproduced on mirror replica 3. attached one failing sample below. only fails when kvcache prefix includes 3rd-party transcript chunk.

sam: can you paste the exact model output? maybe it's trailing control chars or an extra comma.

anya: here — note the trailing zero-width line separator (U+2028) show-up and an escaped newline inside a string that breaks strict parser:

```
{"tool":"labeler","args":{"items":[{"id":42,"label":"bug"},{"id":43,"label":"feature"}]}}
 
```

jordan: oh that U+2028 is nasty — some tokenizers preserve it as a distinct token which can get emitted mid-json. does it come from user transcript?

anya: it looks correlated with pasted transcripts. zephyr2-int4 didn't emit it; raven-int8 did during the same prompt.

lee: could be quantization-induced vocab remap (rare) or beam cutoff inserting sentinel. any diffs in tokenizer outputs?

marco: i pulled tokenized sequences from the run. differences: raven-int8 produces an extra token around 0xE1 which decodes to U+2028 in decoder tables. attaching token hex sequence (trimmed).

```
... 0x42 0x7f 0xe1 0x0a 0x2c ...
```

sam: interesting. we saw a similar remap in a microquant profile last quarter — kernel fallback used a slightly different decode table on Ampere kernels.

anya: test matrix: when we set postproc to strict-json-rescue (auto-wrap + remove-control-chars), pass rate goes back to 97.8 for raven-int8. but that masks root cause.

jordan: agreed we should not ship a bandaid. action plan?

marco: infra-bot created canary job ics-17678 for replay. link: https://ci.redwood/ics/17678 (infra-bot)

infra-bot: Canary job started: ics-17678. logs: https://ci.redwood/ics/17678/logs. status: running.

lee: can we reproduce deterministically on a single device? if yes dump model logits + decoder steps around emission.

anya: done, added a capture for token-level prob and decoder mapping. sample shows raven-int8 decoder mapping flips two high-byte entries only under quant profile PTQ-lite.

sam: that suggests a serialization/weight-quantization table mismatch at compile time. maybe kernel lookup uses different signedness.

anya: hypothesis: during kernel codegen for int8 we used an older vocab->byte map (pre-emoji-fix). it only surfaces when the input contains out-of-vocab char sequences from transcripts.

jordan: what about function-call retries? we saw retries causing truncated suffixes earlier. any interplay here?

anya: yes: retries + kvcache prefix extension increases probability (more tokens in prefix -> more chance to hit that byte sequence). single-shot short prompts rarely fail.

marco: proposed mitigations:
- add schema pass alert for delta > 3% on any quant variant
- block raven-int8 PTQ profile on Dedicated until we root cause
- add a lightweight sanitizer in runtime to normalize-control-chars for canaries only

jordan: +1 to alert and block. sanitizer only for canary/replay for now. we need an owner for root cause.

anya: i'll take ownership for repro and root cause triage. ETA EOD tomorrow.

lee: i'll work w/ infra to audit codegen tables and kernel flags used for raven-int8 builds.

sam: i'll draft a short retro note for the quant onboarding checklist to include token-decode regression tests.

marco: infra-bot: created ticket RWI-2219 (block raven-int8 on Dedicated) and RWI-2220 (schema-alert).

infra-bot: Ticket RWI-2219 created: https://tracker.redwood/RWI-2219. Ticket RWI-2220 created: https://tracker.redwood/RWI-2220.

jordan: any quick workaround for customers? maybe enable json-rescue postproc per-route?

anya: yes we can push a per-route postproc toggle. recommend enabling only on routes with high external transcript ingestion. I'll add rollout playbook.

lee: note: don't enable by default for Hosted until we confirm performance impact — stripping control chars adds ~0.5ms per request in our simple bench.

anya: will include perf numbers in the playbook.

jordan: thanks. priority: block Dedicated profile, alert, and root-cause triage.

sam: can we add a small unit test to onnx/serializer that detects U+2028 decode path mismatch? quick guard.

lee: yes i'll add test + CI job that runs on quant compile step.

anya: closing loop: created a short repro gist with failing sample seeds and tokenizer dumps. gist: https://gist.redwood/g/17678-golden-repro

marco: good job everyone. ping me if you need Dedicated rollback. :thumbsup:

anya: thanks — will update thread when we have root cause.
